<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 620">
  <g id="receptor_skin">
    <!-- Hot surface / Pan -->
    <path d="M 50 490 L 220 490 L 230 520 L 40 520 Z" fill="var(--part-fill, #475569)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #1e293b)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <path d="M 40 500 L 15 480" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #1e293b)" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Heat / Stimulus waves -->
    <path class="curie-pulse" d="M 80 475 Q 90 460 100 475 T 120 475" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #ef4444)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path class="curie-pulse" d="M 130 475 Q 140 460 150 475 T 170 475" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #ef4444)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path class="curie-pulse" d="M 105 455 Q 115 440 125 455 T 145 455" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #f97316)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Finger & Skin Cross-Section -->
    <path d="M 60 360 C 90 370 120 400 135 445 C 145 475 180 475 190 445 C 200 410 220 380 270 370 L 250 330 C 210 340 185 365 175 390 C 160 365 130 335 80 325 Z" fill="var(--part-fill, #fed7aa)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #ea580c)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Epidermis layer detail -->
    <path d="M 125 450 C 135 478 175 478 185 450" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #f97316)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Pain Receptor / Free nerve endings in dermis -->
    <path d="M 155 425 L 140 455 M 155 425 L 155 460 M 155 425 L 170 455 M 140 455 L 132 462 M 140 455 L 145 463 M 170 455 L 165 463 M 170 455 L 178 462" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #dc2626)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </g>

  <g id="sensory_neuron">
    <!-- Sensory Axon Pathway (Afferent) -->
    <path d="M 155 425 C 160 370 230 260 380 230 C 500 205 580 220 660 215 C 675 215 700 215 720 228" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #3b82f6)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Dorsal Root Ganglion (Cell Body Swelling) -->
    <ellipse cx="650" cy="215" rx="18" ry="14" fill="var(--part-fill, #93c5fd)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #1d4ed8)" stroke-width="3" />
    <circle cx="650" cy="215" r="5" fill="var(--part-fill, #1d4ed8)" />
    <!-- Sensory Axon Terminal entering Dorsal Horn -->
    <path d="M 720 228 C 740 240 765 245 780 250" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #3b82f6)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <circle cx="780" cy="250" r="3.5" fill="var(--part-fill, #1d4ed8)" />
    <!-- Directional impulse animation along sensory nerve -->
    <path class="curie-flow" d="M 155 425 C 160 370 230 260 380 230 C 500 205 580 220 660 215 C 675 215 700 215 780 250" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #60a5fa)" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="10 15" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </g>

  <g id="spinal_cord">
    <!-- Spinal Cord Outer White Matter -->
    <path d="M 680 140 C 760 110 880 110 940 180 C 980 230 980 370 940 430 C 880 490 770 500 690 470 C 670 460 655 435 640 410 C 645 375 660 355 675 350 C 660 345 645 325 640 290 C 655 265 670 240 680 230 C 675 200 670 170 680 140 Z" fill="var(--part-fill, #f1f5f9)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #64748b)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Anterior Median Fissure (Deep ventral groove) -->
    <path d="M 675 350 C 720 350 740 350 760 350" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #64748b)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Posterior Median Sulcus -->
    <path d="M 950 290 C 890 290 870 290 850 290" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #94a3b8)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Inner Grey Matter (Butterfly / H-Shape) -->
    <!-- Dorsal horns (right/top), Ventral horns (left/bottom) -->
    <path d="M 785 240 C 800 240 840 200 870 220 C 890 235 870 270 840 280 C 825 285 815 310 815 350 C 815 390 825 415 840 420 C 870 430 890 465 870 480 C 840 500 800 460 785 460 C 770 460 755 425 765 395 C 770 380 770 365 760 350 C 770 335 770 320 765 305 C 755 275 770 240 785 240 Z" fill="var(--part-fill, #cbd5e1)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #475569)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Central Canal -->
    <circle cx="790" cy="350" r="5" fill="var(--part-fill, #475569)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #334155)" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <!-- Ascending pathway branch to brain (faint secondary tract) -->
    <path d="M 785 245 C 805 210 825 150 835 60" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #94a3b8)" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 6" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 828 75 L 835 60 L 845 73" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #94a3b8)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </g>

  <g id="relay_neuron">
    <!-- Relay Neuron (Interneuron) in Dorsal/Ventral Grey Matter -->
    <circle cx="790" cy="275" r="5" fill="var(--part-fill, #10b981)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #047857)" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Synaptic Dendrites connecting to Sensory Terminal -->
    <path d="M 783 255 L 788 270 M 778 260 L 788 270" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #047857)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Axon connecting down to Motor Neuron Dendrites -->
    <path d="M 790 280 C 795 315 780 340 765 370" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #10b981)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Terminal boutons branching at motor neuron synapse -->
    <path d="M 765 370 L 758 382 M 765 370 L 768 384" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #047857)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <circle cx="758" cy="382" r="2.5" fill="var(--part-fill, #047857)" />
    <circle cx="768" cy="384" r="2.5" fill="var(--part-fill, #047857)" />
  </g>

  <g id="motor_neuron">
    <!-- Motor Neuron Cell Body (Multipolar Soma in Ventral Horn) -->
    <polygon points="755,395 765,390 760,405 745,410 745,395" fill="var(--part-fill, #f59e0b)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #b45309)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Dendrites -->
    <path d="M 760 390 L 760 384 M 753 392 L 755 384" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #b45309)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Motor Axon leaving ventral root towards arm effector muscle -->
    <path d="M 745 405 C 700 420 660 415 580 405 C 480 395 430 405 380 415" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #f59e0b)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Neuromuscular Junctions / Motor End Plates -->
    <path d="M 380 415 C 360 420 340 415 320 405 M 340 415 L 330 435 M 355 418 L 350 445" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #b45309)" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <circle cx="320" cy="405" r="4" fill="var(--part-fill, #b45309)" />
    <circle cx="330" cy="435" r="4" fill="var(--part-fill, #b45309)" />
    <circle cx="350" cy="445" r="4" fill="var(--part-fill, #b45309)" />
    <!-- Directional impulse animation along motor nerve -->
    <path class="curie-flow" d="M 755 400 C 700 420 660 415 580 405 C 480 395 430 405 330 435" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #fde68a)" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="10 15" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </g>

  <g id="effector_muscle">
    <!-- Arm / Bicep Muscle (Effector) -->
    <!-- Muscle outline and body -->
    <path d="M 230 410 C 260 365 370 360 410 400 C 430 420 415 460 375 475 C 320 495 255 465 230 410 Z" fill="var(--part-fill, #f87171)" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #b91c1c)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Muscle tendons -->
    <path d="M 230 410 C 215 410 200 405 185 395" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #e2e8f0)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 410 400 C 430 395 445 390 460 385" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #e2e8f0)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Muscle Fascicle / Internal Fiber Striations -->
    <path d="M 270 400 C 310 390 360 395 385 415" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #dc2626)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 265 425 C 305 415 355 420 380 440" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #dc2626)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 280 445 C 315 440 345 445 365 460" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #dc2626)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Muscle Response / Contraction indicator lines -->
    <path class="curie-sway" d="M 310 350 L 325 360 M 345 350 L 340 360 M 330 495 L 335 482 M 350 495 L 345 482" fill="none" stroke="var(--part-stroke, #b91c1c)" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </g>
</svg>
